summary: Improve injury claim records, benefit checks, and return-to-work planning. Explore this practical five-day workers' compensation course.
lede: Workers’ compensation laws and procedures shape how HR, claims and occupational health staff assess injury claims and document decisions. This course builds practical skills in reviewing incident, medical and wage evidence, assessing eligibility and benefit calculations, tracking claim aging, and coordinating suitable-duty return-to-work plans and appeal records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who make, document, or support workplace injury claim decisions and need a consistent process for evidence, deadlines, benefit records, and return-to-work coordination.
modules: Medical Coordination and Return to Work
prerequisites: Prior exposure to HR operations, insurance claims, workplace injury reporting, or workers' compensation administration is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
